name: Exterior Caulking — Joint Prep, Application, Inspection
intent: Complete caulking workflow: ground protect, mask adjacent, stage materials, joint clean, backer rod (when needed), sealant application, inspect, adhesion check, tape remove.
doctrine: Standalone caulk spec. LF-based. Caulk IS the deliverable (not a prep step). Must occur AFTER primer, BEFORE finish coats. No QT, no access modifier (shares access with painting spec). 4 sealant types drive material cost, not labor rate. Simple bead 125 LF/hr, backer rod 87 LF/hr. Silicone excluded — never paintable.
